basic_info.description: Welcome to your perfect urban retreat. This stunning one-bedroom condo features a versatile second bedroom, perfect for a home office or guest space. Enjoy beautiful hardwood floors and an updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances. The dining area opens to a charming private atrium, ideal for morning coffee, while the spacious primary bedroom also offers lots of light with direct access to this serene outdoor space.  In-unit laundry, and the washer and dryer stay. All of this, plus a deeded parking space and extra storage! The beautiful, lush outdoor area is perfect for dog walking and summer barbecues, complemented by a well-equipped gym, sauna, and an enclosed hot tub area for unwinding after a long day. Located in the desirable Mission Dolores neighborhood with a 99% walk score, you'll be steps away from an array of restaurants, coffee shops, bars, shopping, and parks. Enjoy easy biking or walking access to Dolores Park! Close to plenty of public transit. Schedule a viewing today and make this condo your new home sweet home!
